newsitem.title: FINLAND: Benefon jumps on GSM type approval news.
newsitem.headline: Benefon jumps on GSM type approval news.

text.p: Shares in Finnish mobile phones maker Benefon Oy jumped in lively trade on Monday after the company announced it had received type approval for its first GSM handset, brokers said.
At 1115/0915 GMT, Benefon traded at 99.00 markka, up six markka or 6.5 percent after touching 103.00 markka. Trade was a lively 2.1 million markka.

"One hundred markka is about the right price now that they got the GSM approval. The first reaction was an exaggeration," one broker said. Benefon said repeatedly last year that type approval for its first GSM product had been delayed.
